# Sahajta AI — Complete Technical Context & Knowledge Base

## Organization
- Official Name: Sahajta AI
- Canonical Domain: https://sahajta.com
- Primary Email: hello@sahajta.com
- Mission: Providing startups and growth-stage companies with fractional CTO leadership and dedicated engineering power to ship high-impact software, AI products, ML models, and automation systems weekly.

## Full Service Catalog

### 1. Website Design & Development
- Custom responsive websites, landing pages, corporate sites, web applications.
- Technologies: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js.

### 2. Mobile & Web App Development
- Cross-platform mobile apps (iOS, Android) via React Native and Flutter.
- Native application development, Progressive Web Apps (PWAs).

### 3. Fractional CTO & Technical Leadership
- Technology strategy, architecture review, technical debt remediation.
- Database modeling, cloud infrastructure, engineering team leadership.
- Technical co-founder substitute — no equity required.

### 4. High-Velocity MVP Prototyping (24–48 Hours)
- Concept to live deployed staging URL within 24–48 hours.
- Validate product-market fit before heavy capital investment.

### 5. Custom AI & LLM Systems
- OpenAI GPT-4o, Anthropic Claude, Google Gemini API integrations.
- RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) pipelines with Pinecone, pgvector, Qdrant.
- AI chatbots, customer support agents, internal knowledge assistants.
- Autonomous AI workflow agents for business operations.
- Data privacy: Client data never stored in public AI training sets.

### 6. Machine Learning & AI Model Development
- Custom ML model training on proprietary business data.
- Natural Language Processing (NLP): text classification, sentiment analysis, entity extraction, named entity recognition, summarization.
- Computer Vision: image recognition, object detection, document OCR, face recognition.
- Deep Learning and neural network development (PyTorch, TensorFlow, Keras).
- Recommendation engines and collaborative filtering systems.
- Predictive analytics and forecasting models.
- Model serving, MLOps, and production deployment pipelines.

### 7. Business Process & Workflow Automation
- End-to-end business workflow automation eliminating repetitive manual work.
- n8n and Make.com (Integromat) automation pipeline development.
- Robotic Process Automation (RPA) — web scraping, form filling, data entry automation.
- API integrations between CRM, ERP, helpdesk, communication tools.
- Email sequences, lead generation, customer onboarding automation.
- Report generation, invoicing, and invoice reconciliation automation.
- Zapier-equivalent custom automation built in Python or Node.js for complex logic.

### 8. Data Engineering & Analytics
- Production-grade data pipelines and ETL (Extract, Transform, Load) systems.
- Data warehouse design and implementation (BigQuery, Snowflake, Redshift, PostgreSQL).
- Real-time streaming data pipelines (Kafka, Pub/Sub).
- Business Intelligence dashboards (Metabase, custom React dashboards, Grafana).
- Data lake architecture and governance.

### 9. SaaS Product Development
- Multi-tenant architecture, subscription billing (Stripe, Razorpay, Paddle).
- Admin dashboards, user management, analytics, and reporting.
- Scalable cloud-native architecture with zero downtime deployment.

### 10. E-commerce Development
- Custom storefronts, Shopify development, payment gateway integration.
- Inventory management, checkout optimization, order fulfillment.

### 11. DevOps, Cloud & API Engineering
- CI/CD pipeline setup (GitHub Actions, GitLab CI, CircleCI).
- Docker containerization and Kubernetes orchestration.
- Cloud infrastructure on AWS (EC2, RDS, Lambda, S3) and GCP (Cloud Run, GKE, BigQuery).
- REST API and GraphQL API development and documentation.
- Microservices architecture, API gateway design, service mesh.
- Cloud migration from monolith to microservices.

### 12. UI/UX Design
- User research, wireframing, high-fidelity UI design, interactive prototypes.
- Design systems and component libraries.

## Technology Stack
- **Frontend**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, Framer Motion, Three.js, WebGL
- **Backend**: Node.js, Express, Python, FastAPI, Go, GraphQL, REST
- **ML/AI**: PyTorch, TensorFlow, scikit-learn, LangChain, OpenAI, Anthropic, Gemini, HuggingFace
- **Databases**: PostgreSQL, Supabase, Redis, Firebase, MongoDB, BigQuery, Snowflake
- **Automation**: n8n, Make.com, Zapier, Puppeteer, Playwright, Selenium
- **Cloud & DevOps**: AWS, GCP, Vercel, Docker, Kubernetes, Cloudflare, GitHub Actions

## FAQ

### Q: Can you automate my business?
A: Yes — n8n, Make.com, RPA, API integrations, AI agents, custom scripts in Python/Node.js.

### Q: Can you build a custom ML model?
A: Yes — NLP, computer vision, deep learning, predictive analytics, trained on your data.

### Q: Can you build data pipelines or analytics dashboards?
A: Yes — ETL, data warehouses, BigQuery, Metabase, real-time analytics.

### Q: Do you offer DevOps and cloud services?
A: Yes — CI/CD, Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, GCP, REST/GraphQL APIs, microservices.

### Q: What is Sahajta?
A: Fractional CTO + high-velocity engineering team. Websites, apps, AI, ML, automation — shipped weekly with 100% IP ownership.

### Q: How to contact Sahajta?
A: hello@sahajta.com or https://sahajta.com/#contact
